title: Approvals
subtitle: Requests waiting for your decision — attendance corrections, leave and more — and what was decided.

inbox.emptyHint: Requests routed to you — as the manager, the approver of a level, or somebody's delegate — appear here.
inbox.teamEmpty: No pending requests from your team
inbox.historyEmptyHint: Requests you decided, withdrew or were involved in appear here.
inbox.requestsEmptyHint: Requests you filed, or that are about you, appear here with where they stand.
inbox.ownRequestHint: You cannot approve or reject your own request. Withdraw it instead.
inbox.aboutYouHint: Somebody else decides requests about you.
inbox.delegateBanner: You are covering approvals for {{names}} today.

decision.approveHint: Your approval completes this level; the next level is notified, and after the last level the request takes effect.
decision.rejectHint: The requester sees your comment. Under “any one approves”, the others can still approve.
decision.commentRequired: A comment is required when rejecting.
decision.stepApproved: Level approved — waiting for the next approver
decision.approvalRecorded: Approval recorded — waiting for the other approvers
decision.rejectionRecorded: Rejection recorded — the other approvers can still approve
decision.noop: You had already decided this level
decision.overrideHint: You are not an approver of this level: your decision is an organisation-wide override that fills the seat of {{name}}, and it is logged.
decision.escalatedHint: You were added when this level became overdue: your decision fills the seat of {{name}}.
decision.overrideChooseHint: You are not an approver of this level: your decision is an organisation-wide override that fills one approver’s seat, and it is logged. This level needs several approvals, so choose whose seat it fills — the others still decide.
decision.escalatedChooseHint: You were added when this level became overdue: your decision fills one approver’s seat. This level needs several approvals, so choose whose — the others still decide.
decision.decidingForRequired: Choose the approver whose seat your decision fills.

detail.title: Request
detail.notFound: This request does not exist or is not visible to you.
detail.infoRequested: An approver asked for more information.

timeline.invalidated: Superseded — the document changed while pending
timeline.info_request_closed: Open question closed — its level was approved
timeline.sod_owner_bypass: The owner decided a request about themselves
timeline.bypassed: Approved as an exception — the open levels were skipped
timeline.system_rejected: Rejected automatically — it can no longer be approved

info.askHint: The requester is notified; the request stays pending until somebody decides it.
info.answerHint: The approvers of the current level are notified.

reassign.title: Reassign the current level
reassign.hint: The current approvers are replaced by the person you choose; they are told why.
reassign.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the manager is on leave

withdraw.title: Withdraw this request?
withdraw.hint: The approvers are told why; the document goes back to where it was before the request.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.subtitle: Let a colleague decide your approvals while you are away. They act in your seat: what they decide counts as yours.
delegations.emptyHint: When you are away, delegate your approvals so nothing waits for you.
delegations.revokeHint: The delegate can no longer decide your approvals. Requests already decided stay decided.
delegations.onBehalfHint: HR can delegate on somebody else's behalf; leave empty for yourself.

email.title: Confirm your decision
email.approveHint: You are about to approve the request from your e-mail.
email.rejectHint: You are about to reject the request from your e-mail. The requester will see your comment.
email.invalid: This link is incomplete or not meant for this account.
email.notWaiting: This request no longer waits for your decision from this link (it is {{status}}, or your level was decided or moved). Open it in the app to see what happened.

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.subtitle: Who approves what, in which order. A branch-specific workflow wins over an organisation-wide one, and the highest tier a request reaches applies. Without a workflow, HR's own entries apply at once and everybody else's go to the holders of the approve permission.
workflows.dialogHint: Up to 5 levels, decided in order.
workflows.branchScopeHint: Leave empty for an organisation-wide workflow.
workflows.isDefaultHint: New requests in its scope use this workflow.
workflows.minUnitsHint: Tier: applies from this size up (leave days, overtime minutes). Empty = any size.
workflows.appliesHint: Optional: narrow the workflow to some branches or departments.
workflows.singleSeatQuorum: This approver type is one person: it cannot require more than 1 approval.

hint.MANAGER: The employee's manager; the secondary manager when the manager is absent or on leave, then HR.
hint.MANAGER_CHAIN: Walks up the reporting line; a shorter line stops at the most senior manager reachable.
hint.HR_ADMIN: Every HR admin of the branch.
hint.DEPARTMENT_HEAD: The manager of the employee's department.
hint.BRANCH_MANAGER: The branch managers of the employee's branch.

workflows.emptyHint: Without a workflow, corrections and leave go to the holders of the approve permission in reach of the employee.
workflows.deleteHint: Pending requests already routed through this workflow keep their levels.

bypass.title: Approve as an exception
bypass.hint: Approves the request now and skips every level still open. The approvers who were waiting are told, and the reason is kept in the timeline and the audit log.
bypass.placeholder: Why this request cannot wait for its approvers
